description:
Configure automated notifications for the TB Treatment Card programme in DHIS2. Log in as admin/district. Navigate to the Maintenance app, find the TB Treatment Card programme, and create two notification templates: 
1. 'TB Case Enrollment Alert': Triggered on program enrollment, sent to users at the organisation unit. The message should notify that a new TB case has been enrolled. 
2. 'TB Treatment Follow-up Reminder': Triggered 7 days after the scheduled due date, sent to users at the organisation unit. The message should warn about overdue follow-up. 
Ensure both templates are saved and associated with the TB programme.
